messages:
priya_releases: Quick heads-up — planning to lift the soft-pin for runtime v2.16 in eu-west canary tonight at 21:00 UTC. This unpin will let us test the new kernel selector with llama3q-quant and SDK 3.4. Deploybot will run preflight checks and auto-unpin only on all-green. Can folks do a rapid compatibility sniff?

kevin_dev: FYI SDK 3.4 introduced a client payload deserialiser change that broke older shims. I filed a tiny server-side shim PR earlier but haven't merged. If deploybot flags `sdk-client` we should hold.

maria_platform: We merged the runtime side KVCACHE fix into 2.16-rc, but that build isn't promoted to hosted yet. If kv-cache alarms show up in preflight we should avoid unpin.

sam_sre: Telemetry note — last run of 2.16 in longseq sims showed a 12% increase in KV cache evictions on eu-west-1. Not a showstopper but could surface under heavy inference.

deploybot: Preflight summary for canary target (eu-west, runtime=2.16, model=llama3q-quant, sdk=3.4): model-check: OK; runtime-check: WARN(kvcache: +12% evictions); sdk-check: FAIL(client-payload-compat).

priya_releases: Ok that's actionable. Kevin — how fast can the shim PR land? If we can drop it before 20:30 UTC we can rerun preflight and unpin at 21:00. If not, we'll postpone.

kevin_dev: I can cut the PR to main and request a hotpatch merge. ETA ~25m. It only touches the deserialiser fallback. I'll @maria_platform for a quick smoke.

maria_platform: I can promote the runtime hotfix to hosted staging after the shim lands, but deploybot preflight will need to run again. Also suggest adding a temporary pin override on the model route to prevent auto-unpin if anything fails during the window.

priya_releases: Good call. Proposed manual gating: deploybot auto-unpin only if all checks = OK. If any WARN or FAIL, deploybot should keep the soft-pin and we follow rollback/runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/unpin-failure (refer). Can we also set a temporary hold until 22:00 UTC to avoid surprise churn?

sam_sre: Agree. For metrics gating: require kv-cache evictions delta < 5% and 99th latency not worse than +8%. If SDK check fails it's a hard block.

maria_platform: Command to add short hold (if needed):
```
/deploybot pin add --scope canary --target runtime:2.16 --until 2026-03-23T22:00:00Z --reason "hold for SDK shim + kvcache smoke"
```

kevin_dev: I'm starting the PR now, will ping when ready.

priya_releases: Thanks. If we hit block we'll postpone the unpin by 24h and notify product owners. I'll watch preflight and post updates here. :thumbsup:

deploybot: Locking soft-pin for runtime:2.16 on canary until 22:00 UTC pending manual release. Preflight re-run scheduled at 20:35 UTC.

kevin_dev: PR up and requesting review — link: https://github.com/redwood/shims/pull/1234 — cc @maria_platform

maria_platform: Reviewed and starting a quick hosted staging promote after CI. Will report smoke results here (~10m).

sam_sre: Noted. I will keep the alert channel open and run an ad-hoc longseq test once staging promote completes.

priya_releases: Awesome — appreciate the quick turn. We'll hold this thread for updates.
